hooks.name: Auto-documentación al crear/modificar compose.yml
hooks.description: When a compose.yml is saved, checks if catalog documentation exists and generates missing pieces (ficha, guide, .env.example). Follows the labels-first Homepage philosophy.

action.prompt:
A compose.yml file was just saved or modified. Follow the catalog-sync pipeline:

1. Read the compose.yml that was saved
2. Identify the service name from its parent directory
3. Check if documentation already exists for this service:
   - agent/catalog/services/<svc>/ficha.md
   - docs/services/<svc>-guide.md
4. If ANY documentation is missing, generate it following these rules:
   - ficha.md: Extract image, ports, networks, env vars, healthcheck, volumes from compose. Use the template in agent/catalog/_template.md
   - compose.yml in catalog: Copy the saved compose.yml
   - .env.example: Sanitize secrets (PASSWORD/TOKEN/KEY/SECRET → __pega_aqui__)
   - Guide placeholder (docs/services/<svc>-guide.md): Only if it doesn't exist. Include service name, port, image, basic structure
   - Homepage labels: If the compose doesn't have homepage.* labels, suggest adding them
5. Update docker-nas/SKILL.md table if a new guide was created
6. Notify the user what was generated

IMPORTANT: Never overwrite existing documentation — only generate what's missing.
If everything exists already, just confirm "Documentation up to date for <svc>".
